description:
Look up one protein in UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot, the reviewed section of UniProt, and return what its curators state: subcellular location, function, and GO cellular-component terms. Use this when the question is where a named protein is located in the cell, what it does, or which compartment terms it has, and you have a UniProt accession (P05771), an entry name (KPCB_HUMAN), a gene symbol (PRKCB), or the exact protein name. One protein per call; `organism` defaults to human.

Each location and function statement carries an evidence label and, where UniProt cites one, a `pmid:` paper ID. Among these statements, only those whose label starts with "Experimental" are measurements. Every other label, such as "Inferred from a related protein", "Curator inference", "Predicted from sequence", or "No evidence tag", is not, so report the label with the statement. The GO cellular-component terms carry no such label. Every GO term listed has experimental evidence, shown by its GO code (IDA and the like) and the group that assigned it. When a location statement and a GO term name the same compartment with different evidence, say which one the compartment rests on, for example "curated location has no evidence tag; GO term mitochondrion is experimental, IDA, HPA". Open a cited paper with firecrawl_research_inspect_paper or firecrawl_research_read_paper.

Not for free-text questions, topics, diseases, or lists of proteins (use firecrawl_research_search_papers), and not for structures, compounds, interactions, or unreviewed entries. If a symbol names several proteins, the result lists candidates; call again with one accession.

organism.description: Organism that scopes a gene symbol or protein name: an NCBI taxon ID (`10090`), a scientific name (`Mus musculus`), or a UniProt common name (`Mouse`). Defaults to human (`9606`). Accessions and entry names ignore it.

protein.description: One protein identifier: a UniProt accession (`P05771`; an isoform ID such as `P05771-2` resolves to its entry), an entry name (`KPCB_HUMAN`), a gene symbol (`PRKCB`), or the exact protein name (`Protein kinase C beta type`). Not a question or a sentence.

name: firecrawl_research_lookup_protein

outputSchema.description: The curated UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot annotation of one protein, the candidates for an ambiguous name, or no match.

candidateCount.description: Total number of candidate entries, when `match` is `ambiguous`.

gene.description: Primary gene name, when UniProt gives one.

organism.description: `{taxonId, scientificName, commonName}` of the source organism.

candidates.description: Up to ten entries the input could name, when `match` is `ambiguous`; look one up by its accession.

notice.description: Attribution and license of the UniProt data.

eco.description: Evidence and Conclusion Ontology code, such as `ECO:0000269`.

fromProtein.description: Accession of the related entry a `by_similarity` statement was inferred from.

kind.description: `experimental`, `large_scale_experimental`, `author_statement`, `curator_inference`, `by_similarity`, `sequence_analysis`, `imported`, or `untagged`. Only the two experimental kinds are measurements.

paperId.description: Cited paper, such as `pmid:27974379`; accepted by the inspect and read paper tools.

evidence.description: What supports the statement, in UniProt order.

molecule.description: The isoform or chain the statement applies to, when UniProt names one.

note.description: True for the free-text note of a location comment.

text.description: The statement as UniProt writes it: a location term, a note, or a function description.

gene.description: Primary gene name, when UniProt gives one.

paperIds.description: Papers cited for the term. Empty when none is loaded for it; only GO terms of human entries have paper IDs.

goCellularComponent.description: GO cellular-component terms with experimental evidence codes.

organism.description: `{taxonId, scientificName, commonName}` of the source organism.

paperIds.description: Every paper ID cited above, deduplicated.

eco.description: Evidence and Conclusion Ontology code, such as `ECO:0000269`.

fromProtein.description: Accession of the related entry a `by_similarity` statement was inferred from.

kind.description: `experimental`, `large_scale_experimental`, `author_statement`, `curator_inference`, `by_similarity`, `sequence_analysis`, `imported`, or `untagged`. Only the two experimental kinds are measurements.

evidence.description: What supports the statement, in UniProt order.

molecule.description: The isoform or chain the statement applies to, when UniProt names one.

note.description: True for the free-text note of a location comment.

text.description: The statement as UniProt writes it: a location term, a note, or a function description.

release.description: UniProt release the answer was read from, such as `2026_04`.
